description: Browse articles, fetch chart data, or explore country profiles from ourworldindata.org.

chartSlug.description: The URL slug of an OWID Grapher chart, e.g. `life-expectancy` or `co2-emissions-vs-gdp`. Found in the chart URL: ourworldindata.org/grapher/{slug}.
chartSlug.title: Chart slug (mode=chartData)

chartSlugs.description: List of OWID Grapher chart slugs to download data for (mode=chartDataBulk).
chartSlugs.title: Chart slugs (mode=chartDataBulk)

entities.description: For chart data modes: only include rows for these entities (e.g. ['United States', 'Germany', 'World']). Leave empty for all.
entities.title: Filter by entities (countries/regions)

includeChartConfig.description: For chart data modes: include the chart's config (title, subtitle, citation) as a metadata record before the data rows.
includeChartConfig.title: Include chart config metadata

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to scrape from Our World in Data.
enumTitles: Chart Data — download CSV data for a specific chart by slug
Chart Data Bulk — download data for multiple chart slugs
Countries — browse country profiles from OWID
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Filter articles whose title or excerpt contains this keyword (case-insensitive). Leave empty to return all recent articles.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=articles)

topic.description: Filter articles by OWID topic area. Leave empty for all topics.
topic.title: Topic filter (mode=articles)

yearFrom.description: Only include chart data rows from this year onwards.
yearFrom.title: Year from (chart data modes)

yearTo.description: Only include chart data rows up to this year (inclusive).
yearTo.title: Year to (chart data modes)

title: Our World in Data Scraper Input
